title: Built a 2D dark-fantasy survival roguelite in Unity 6 with 8 unique champions, 40 awakening runes, and 4 stages — looking for playtesters & honest feedback!
author: GUNGNIR95
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev! I've been building **Wavebreaker** (under **TenacityWorks**), a 2D dark-fantasy action-survival roguelite in **Unity 6**, and just put up a free Windows playtest build to gather feedback.

🌐 **Showcase & Hero Roster:** [https://tenacity-works.github.io/Wavebreaker/](https://tenacity-works.github.io/Wavebreaker/) ⬇️ **Playable Windows Download (.zip) & Repo:** [https://github.com/Tenacity-Works/Wavebreaker/releases/latest](https://github.com/Tenacity-Works/Wavebreaker/releases/latest) *(Just extract the .zip and run* `Wavebreaker.exe` *— since it's an unsigned indie playtest build, click "More info → Run anyway" if Windows SmartScreen pops up.)*

# What's in the playtest right now:

* **8 Champions with truly distinct kits** (not stat reskins): twin-stick sword waves, boomerang/ricochet archery, shatter-freeze mage, melee cleave/spin juggernaut, chain-explosion valkyrie, HP-sacrifice/overheal necromancer, held chain-lightning conduit, and a high-mobility katana dasher.
* **Manual Aim or Toggleable Auto-Aim (**`F`**):** Play it like a twin-stick action game or toggle lock-on to focus purely on movement and dodging.
* **40 Character Runes + Awakenings:** Bind 2 signature runes per run (Lv. 10 & 25) and Awaken them into evolved forms (Lv. 50 & 80).
* **4 Unlockable 15-Minute Stages:** Each with its own enemy roster, encirclement waves, and telegraphed 13-minute Final Bosses, plus Tier I & Tier II permanent Power-Ups.

# AI + Unity Workflow Notes:

* Built with AI-assisted C# architecture and custom URP shaders (selective pixel-flame motion shaders on weapons/auras that keep character faces/armor crisp, automated runtime alpha-cutout pipelines, and 4-quadrant high-density terrain reconstruction).

# What I'd love feedback on:

1. **Game feel & hitboxes:** Does weaving through crowds and dodging telegraphed boss attacks feel fair and responsive?
2. **Champion & Rune balance:** Which champion did you try, and did any rune feel super fun or underwhelming?
3. **Progression pacing:** How did the gold curve and difficulty ramp feel across your first couple of runs?

Happy to answer any questions about the Unity/shader/AI workflow too—thanks for checking it out! I have been working on this game for a week and it just started as a hobby of mine, I started this project as a way to get to learn AI coding more and I am not an expert in this area by any means. Any feedback is appreciated. I mainly used Antigravity and Codex both for image generation and coding.
